result.topic_en: Calculations of the linearized perturbation equations for small oscillations of a rotating fluid ellipsoid, deriving the characteristic (frequency) equation in mu and simplifying coefficients such as alpha alpha' + delta delta' in terms of the semi-axes a, b, c.

methods.what: Linearized perturbation equations for small oscillations, with coupling coefficients depending on semi-axes and rotation parameters w, w'
methods.quote: $(b-c)\frac{\partial \delta u}{\partial t} + [-\frac{\partial \delta u'}{\partial t}-] \delta u + (b+c-2a) w\,\delta v + (b+c+2a) w'\,\delta v' = 0$

methods.what: Abbreviated second-order system with coefficients alpha, beta, gamma, delta
methods.quote: $-\frac{\partial^2 \delta u}{\partial t^2} + (\alpha\alpha' w^2 + \beta\gamma' w'^2)\delta u + w w'(\alpha\beta' + \beta\delta')\,\delta u'$

methods.what: Characteristic (frequency) equation as a 2x2 determinant, quartic in mu
methods.quote: $(\mu\mu + \alpha\alpha' w^2 + \beta\gamma' w'^2)(\mu\mu + \gamma\beta' w'^2 + \delta\delta' w^2) = (\alpha\beta' + \beta\delta')(\gamma\alpha' + \delta\gamma') w^2 w'^2$

methods.what: Factorization of the constant term of the quartic
Completed-square form of the quartic giving discriminant
methods.quote: $(2\mu^2 + (\alpha\alpha' + \delta\delta') w^2 + (\gamma\beta' + \beta\gamma') w'^2)^2 = (\alpha\alpha' - \delta\delta')^2 w^4 + (\gamma\beta' - \beta\gamma')^2 w'^4 + 2 w^2 w'^2 (\alpha\alpha' - \delta\delta')(\beta\gamma' - \beta'\gamma) + 4 w w'^2 (\alpha\beta' + \beta\delta')(\delta\gamma' + \gamma\alpha')$

methods.what: Partial-fraction evaluation of coefficient alpha alpha' + delta delta'
Polynomial simplification of numerator of the coefficient
Special case b=a: characteristic equation coefficient and perfect-square constant term
Ratio w'^2/w^2 from equilibrium condition, and special case c=a
